title: Chocolate Chip and Coconut Pancakes
changes_from_base: The same buttermilk and soured cream batter, with chocolate chips and shredded coconut scattered over each pancake before flipping.
summary: Soft, pillowy pancakes studded with chocolate chips and shredded coconut, a tropical-meets-indulgent treat.
equipment: nonstick frying pan (30 cm) or griddle
wire rack set in a rimmed baking tray

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
unsalted butter, melted and cooled slightly

steps.title: Prepare oven and mix dry
steps.text: Heat oven to 93 °C; spray a wire rack and put it in the oven on its tray. Whisk 283 g plain flour, 2 tbsp caster sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, ½ tsp bicarbonate of soda and ½ tsp fine salt.

steps.title: Mix wet
steps.text: Whisk 480 ml buttermilk, 2 large eggs, 60 ml soured cream and 42 g unsalted butter (melted and cooled slightly), pour into a well in the flour and stir gently until just combined (lumpy); rest 10 min.

steps.title: Prepare topping
steps.text: Mix 170 g plain chocolate chips and 40 g sweetened shredded coconut.

steps.title: Heat pan
steps.text: Heat 1 tsp vegetable oil in a 30 cm non-stick frying pan over medium heat until shimmering and wipe out the excess.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook 4 pancakes of 60 ml each until the edges are set, the base is golden and bubbles begin to break (2-3 min); sprinkle each with 1 tbsp of the chip mixture. Flip and cook 1-2 min more. Serve straight away or keep warm on the rack; repeat, adding the remaining oil as needed.

tips: Mix the chocolate chips and coconut before cooking so you can measure them evenly for each pancake.
Sprinkle the mixture on the pancake after the base has set (when you can see bubbles breaking); this lets the chips warm through rather than melt away into the batter.
The subtle coconut flavour works beautifully with chocolate without dominating; for more intensity, add an extra 1 tbsp.
storage: Best served fresh and warm. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
